context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n feature fully tested. Frontend uses Zustand store (languageStore.js) with localStorage persistence (key: bq_lang). useTranslation hook reads from fr.json/en.json. All game modes (quiz_qui_a_dit, quiz_vrai_faux, mots_caches, labyrinthe_exode, chrono_versets, anagrammes) return content in requested language.
